hash_note: canonical JSON is utf-8 with sort_keys and separators (',', ':'). statevector hash is sha256 of little-endian float64 real bytes followed by float64 imag bytes, C-order, of the vector as produced here. A second hash rounds real and imag to 8 decimal places before the same packing.
normalization: same ±1 triangle coefficients at every N; Gamma is not divided by N or by Gamma*

payload.H: -sum_up ZZZ + sum_down ZZZ - Gamma * sum X
payload.bit: index x+Lx*y is bit q, LSB = qubit 0
payload.normalization: triangle coefficients exactly -1 (up) and +1 (down); not divided by N
